download_notes: All accepted PDFs are complete original publisher files, 4-15 pages, and were validated for PDF page count and SHA-256.
CellFIT and STROBE succeeded after bounded transfer retries. Initial concurrent curl failures included schannel missing close_notify; no access-control restriction was bypassed.

The 15 MB GSTools download was incomplete after bounded retries and excluded. It was replaced by the official 4-page CC BY DAMASK Python paper before ground-truth inspection/model comparison. Failed partial downloads are not in papers[].
